name: onboarding
title: Onboarding
description: A paged welcome with animated illustration panels, a progress line that follows the swipe and word-by-word titles.

perf.budget: Only the current slide's illustration animates (UI-thread springs and loops); the others rest. The progress line is a scroll-driven worklet.

measurements.notes: Animating at rest: the current slide’s illustration keeps drifting or looping while it is on screen.

a11y.reducedMotion: Illustrations show their finished state without looping, and titles appear without rising (Word Cascade). Paging is user-driven, so it stays.
a11y.screenReader: Only the current slide is exposed. The progress line reads "Step 2 of 3". The button is named Continue, then Get started; Maybe later is a separate button.
a11y.touchTarget: The main button is 56 pt tall; Maybe later is at least 44 pt.
